analysis: The method getKeyUse checks if the input keyUse is null; if so, it returns null. Otherwise, it enters a switch statement that returns KeyUse.SIG for "sig", KeyUse.ENC for "enc", and null for the default case. The method does not call any external functions, and there are no operations that could throw runtime exceptions (e.g., array access, division, type casting, etc.). The null check prevents NullPointerException. All code paths return a value. No runtime exceptions are possible, so no exception handling is needed.
